fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay in The Gambia.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estadía en Gambia.
entry.quote: your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay

entry.en: An Airport Security Fee of 20 US dollars is payable on arrival and departure, also accepted in euros, pounds or local currency.
entry.es: Se paga una tasa de seguridad aeroportuaria de 20 dólares al llegar y al salir, que también se acepta en euros, libras o moneda local.
entry.quote: You must pay an Airport Security Fee when you arrive in and leave the country. The fee is 20 US dollars, which can also be paid in euros, British pounds, or local currency.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: You may need a yellow fever certificate for onward travel to some other countries.
entry.es: Podrías necesitar un certificado de fiebre amarilla para seguir viaje a otros países.
entry.quote: You may need a yellow fever certificate for onward travel to some other countries

entry.en: Driving across the border in a private vehicle, you may be asked to pay a vehicle registration fee.
entry.es: Si cruzas la frontera en un vehículo particular, podrían pedirte una tasa de registro del vehículo.
entry.quote: If you are driving across the border in a private vehicle you may be asked to pay a vehicle registration fee.

entry.en: There are strict rules on goods taken into or out of The Gambia, and you must declare anything prohibited or dutiable.
entry.es: Hay normas estrictas sobre los bienes que entran o salen de Gambia y debes declarar lo prohibido o sujeto a impuestos.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of The Gambia. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Be cautious of young men known as 'bumsters' who approach tourists offering help or to act as guides.
safety.es: Ten cuidado con jóvenes conocidos como 'bumsters' que abordan a turistas ofreciendo ayuda o guiarlos.
safety.quote: Be cautious of young men locally known as ‘bumsters’ who approach tourists, particularly on beaches, offering help or to act as local guides.

safety.en: There are reports of passports and other valuables being stolen from hotel rooms.
safety.es: Hay reportes de robo de pasaportes y otros objetos de valor en habitaciones de hotel.
safety.quote: There are reports of passports and other valuables being stolen from hotel rooms.

safety.en: Corruption is present at all levels and you may be asked for bribes.
safety.es: La corrupción está presente a todos los niveles y pueden pedirte sobornos.
safety.quote: Corruption is present at all levels and you may be asked for bribes.

safety.en: Driving standards are poor, roads are severely potholed and lighting is poor after dark.
safety.es: La conducción es deficiente, las carreteras tienen muchos baches y hay poca iluminación de noche.
safety.quote: Driving standards are poor, roads are severely potholed and after dark there is poor road and vehicle lighting.

safety.en: The Banjul-Barra ferry is often overcrowded and overloaded.
safety.es: El ferri Banjul-Barra suele ir sobrecargado y abarrotado.
safety.quote: The ferry service from Banjul to Barra is operating but it is often overcrowded and overloaded.

safety.en: There is zero tolerance towards LGBT+ people, and same-sex relationships are illegal.
safety.es: Hay tolerancia cero hacia las personas LGBT+ y las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales.
safety.quote: There is a zero tolerance towards LGBT+ people in The Gambia. Same-sex relationships are illegal and could lead to lengthy prison sentences.

health.en: Medical facilities are very limited and the cost of medical evacuation can be very high.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son muy limitados y el costo de una evacuación médica puede ser muy alto.
health.quote: Medical facilities in The Gambia are very limited and the cost of medical evacuation can be very high.

health.en: Yellow fever vaccination is strongly recommended.
health.es: Se recomienda mucho la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla.
health.quote: Yellow fever vaccination is strongly recommended.

health.en: Most cases of malaria in The Gambia are contracted between June and December.
health.es: La mayoría de los casos de malaria en Gambia se contraen entre junio y diciembre.
health.quote: Most cases of malaria in The Gambia are contracted between June and December.

health.en: Residents say tap water is drinkable, but bottled or boiled water is advised for travelers.
health.es: Los residentes dicen que el agua del grifo es potable, pero a los viajeros se les aconseja agua embotellada o hervida.
health.quote: Residents say the tap water is drinkable, but for travelers bottled or boiled water is advised

health.en: Some medicines, such as those containing codeine or diazepam, are banned under Gambian drugs laws.
health.es: Algunos medicamentos, como los que contienen codeína o diazepam, están prohibidos por las leyes de drogas de Gambia.
health.quote: Some prescription and over-the-counter medicines like those containing codeine or diazepam are banned under The Gambia’s drugs laws.

health.en: Private clinics will only treat fee-paying patients.
health.es: Las clínicas privadas solo atienden a pacientes que pagan.
health.quote: Private clinics will only treat fee-paying patients.

help.en: There is no equivalent to the UK's 999 emergency number in The Gambia.
help.es: En Gambia no existe un equivalente al 999 del Reino Unido.
help.quote: There is no equivalent to the UK’s 999 emergency number in The Gambia.

help.en: Individual police and fire stations have their own numbers, often mobile numbers.
help.es: Cada estación de policía y bomberos tiene su propio número, a menudo móvil.
help.quote: Individual police stations and fire stations have their own numbers (these are often mobile numbers, as many do not have a landline).

getting_in.en: Banjul is the only international airport in The Gambia.
getting_in.es: Banjul es el único aeropuerto internacional de Gambia.
getting_in.quote: Banjul (BJL IATA) is the only international airport in The Gambia.

getting_in.en: During the tourist season (October to April) there are regular direct flights from cities such as London, Amsterdam and Frankfurt.
getting_in.es: En temporada turística (octubre a abril) hay vuelos directos regulares desde ciudades como Londres, Ámsterdam y Fráncfort.
getting_in.quote: During the tourist season (October to April), there are regular scheduled flights direct from cities such as London, Birmingham, Manchester, Amsterdam, Frankfurt and Brussels.

getting_in.en: Bush taxis run from Dakar to the Gambian border at Karang, then another taxi to Barra and a 30-minute ferry to Banjul.
getting_in.es: Taxis colectivos van de Dakar a la frontera gambiana en Karang; luego otro taxi a Barra y un ferri de 30 minutos a Banjul.
getting_in.quote: Sept-places or bush taxis run from Dakar to Gambia's border, Karag. From there you must take another Taxi to Barra and then a 30 minutes Ferry to Banjul.

getting_in.en: It is possible to drive your private car from Senegal via the border town of Amdalli, just north of Barra.
getting_in.es: Es posible entrar desde Senegal en auto particular por la ciudad fronteriza de Amdalli, al norte de Barra.
getting_in.quote: It is possible use your private car to drive from Senegal to The Gambia via the border town of Amdalli (just north of Barra).

getting_around.en: There are green tourist cabs and yellow regular cabs.
getting_around.es: Hay taxis verdes (para turistas) y amarillos (regulares).
getting_around.quote: There are two types of cabs: green ones (tourist cabs) and yellow ones (regular cabs).

getting_around.en: Yellow taxis are much cheaper, with the price depending on the number of people in the cab.
getting_around.es: Los taxis amarillos son mucho más baratos y el precio depende del número de personas.
getting_around.quote: Yellow taxis are much cheaper and the price depends on the number of persons in the cab.

getting_around.en: Buses are generally not air conditioned and have no bathrooms on board.
getting_around.es: Los buses generalmente no tienen aire acondicionado ni baño a bordo.
getting_around.quote: Buses are generally not air conditioned and do not have bathrooms on board, so prepare accordingly.

getting_around.en: A 4WD is recommended if renting a car, since roads are often in bad condition and only a minority are paved.
getting_around.es: Se recomienda un 4x4 si alquilas auto, pues los caminos suelen estar en mal estado y pocos están pavimentados.
getting_around.quote: A 4WD is recommended if you plan to rent a car, since the roads often are in bad condition and only a minority is paved.

getting_around.en: Using your thumb to hitch is an obscene gesture, so wave instead to stop a car.
getting_around.es: Usar el pulgar para pedir aventón es un gesto obsceno; en su lugar, saluda con la mano para detener un auto.
getting_around.quote: It is an obscene gesture in The Gambia, instead wave if you want a car to stop.

money.en: The Gambia uses the dalasi as its currency.
money.es: Gambia usa el dalasi como moneda.
money.quote: The Gambia uses the dalasi as its currency

money.en: The Gambia is primarily cash-based, and few places accept credit cards although more accept Visa.
money.es: Gambia funciona sobre todo con efectivo; pocos lugares aceptan tarjetas de crédito, aunque cada vez más aceptan Visa.
money.quote: The Gambia is primarily a cash-based economy. Check with your tour operator or hotel before travelling. An increasing number of hotels and restaurants accept Visa cards but very few accept credit cards.

money.en: There are not many ATMs outside the Senegambia tourist area, and elsewhere they can be unreliable.
money.es: Hay pocos cajeros fuera de la zona turística de Senegambia y en otros lugares pueden no funcionar bien.
money.quote: There are not many ATMs outside the tourist area of Senegambia. In other locations, ATMs can be unreliable.

money.en: It is better to bring CFA francs, euros or US dollars.
money.es: Es mejor llevar francos CFA, euros o dólares estadounidenses.
money.quote: It is better you take CFA francs, euro or US dollars with you.

money.en: MasterCard and Visa can be used at any GT Bank or EcoBank ATM to withdraw cash.
money.es: MasterCard y Visa sirven en cualquier cajero de GT Bank o EcoBank para retirar efectivo.
money.quote: MasterCard and Visa can be used at any GT Bank or EcoBank ATMs to withdraw cash.

etiquette.en: Always ask before photographing anyone, as some Gambians have beliefs about having their picture taken by a stranger.
etiquette.es: Pregunta siempre antes de fotografiar a alguien, pues algunos gambianos tienen creencias sobre que un extraño les tome fotos.
etiquette.quote: Always ask before you take a photo of anyone. Some Gambians have certain beliefs about having their picture taken, in particular by a stranger.

etiquette.en: The Gambia is an Islamic country, so respect local customs and laws, especially during Ramadan or at religious areas.
etiquette.es: Gambia es un país islámico: respeta costumbres y leyes locales, sobre todo en Ramadán o en zonas religiosas.
etiquette.quote: The Gambia is an Islamic country. Respect local traditions, customs, laws and religions. Make sure your actions do not cause offence, especially during the holy month of Ramadan or if you intend to visit religious areas.

connectivity.en: Africell is the major 4G operator, with sale points nearly everywhere; bring your passport and get an activated SIM in minutes.
connectivity.es: Africell es el principal operador 4G, con puntos de venta casi en todas partes; con tu pasaporte te dan una SIM activada en minutos.
connectivity.quote: Africell is the major 4G operator in the country and sell points can be found nearly everywhere. They will ask for your passport and will sell you an activated SIM card in minutes.

connectivity.en: The connection is usually good in Banjul and the Senegambia beach area.
connectivity.es: La conexión suele ser buena en Banjul y en la zona de playa de Senegambia.
connectivity.quote: The connection is usually good in Banjul and Senegambia beach area.
